rules.description: Ctrl is Control and Alt is Meta in kitty and Ghostty (PC muscle memory, alongside the setup-macos modifier rotation)
Ctrl+Shift+C interrupts in Terminal and iTerm2, as Control+C, and Ctrl+C stays copy (PC muscle memory, alongside the setup-macos modifier rotation)
Ctrl is Control and Alt is Meta in Terminal and iTerm2, as in kitty, Ctrl+C and Ctrl+V staying copy and paste (PC muscle memory, alongside the setup-macos modifier rotation)
